comment.narrative: According to the project application the development of just one qualification Housing manager was planned. This includes the professional standard the training programme based on the standard and the introduction of this qualification at vocational schools. The project partners decided at the beginning of the project to establish additionally the qualification of Caretaker. The background was the increasing need for this qualification in housing management in both countries. The caretaker is an assistant manager who works with residents homeowners and does various housekeeping works according to a catalogue of services.At the beginning of the project the situation was as follows KAZ The professional standards Caretaker and Manager of multifamily buildings were already developed as part of the previous EU project PRO HOUSE the predecessor to PROMHOUSE. UZB There were no professional standards Caretaker and Housing manager at the beginning of the project.
Standards for professional housing management implemented in KAZ and UZB Educational programme elaborated on the basis of the developed standard and approved by the state authorities.

KAZ professional standards implemented. Educational programme elaborated on the basis of the developed standard and approved by the state authoritiesUZB professional standard housing manager implemented. Uyzhoy zhuzhaligi boshkaruvchisi Uyzhoy manager. The developers are representatives of the MZhKO RUz. and the ASSOCIATION UYUSHMASI. The Mintrud RUz. was offered a new professional standard Specialist of Housing and Communal Services Caretaker uzb. Uyzhoy va kommunal huzhligi mutahassisi House Master according to the letter of the MZhKO of RUz. as of 08.11.2022. The developers of the new professional standard are the MZhKO of RUz. and the ASSOCIATION UYUSHMASI. Annex3UZBpolicyprocess11reportwork of the associationdevelopmentprofessionalstandardsru.pdf.
